0.original: Urianger wishes to take stock of the situation.

24.original: Speak with Urianger in Sinus Lacrimarum.

48.original: I'm not wrong to call them that, am I? Friends.

49.original: Garlean technology shall enrich my people's lives and empower them to achieve great new feats. I am particularly eager to see what our alchemists are inspired to create.

50.original: Moments like these give me hope that we still have a place in this world...

51.original: Both Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han and Garlemald stand to benefit greatly from this agreement. It may well mark the beginning of a long and fruitful relationship.

52.original: "Good friends,“ eh? And coming from her, you know she's not just saying it to be nice.

53.original: The moon... When Zenos brought me here, I remember feeling surprised that such a desolate place could exist in the Source.

55.original: The trade agreement discussions do not require our input, so Alisaie and I are free to attend to the Tower of Babil without distractions.

57.original: This seal we mean to erect─I assume it won't hinder a half-voidsent like me from going in the other direction.

58.original: Y'shtola hath done well indeed to devise a seal in so short a time. 'Tis a testament to her ingenuity in times of need.

59.original: How did you fare with the preparations below?

60.original: So this is one of the brands that once imprisoned Zodiark... Were I to describe it to my comrades back home, I doubt my words could do it justice.

61.original: <hex:024804F2022303>What aid I lend in restoring the brands is insignificant next to that which you and yours must accomplish.<hex:0248020103>

62.original: <hex:024804F2022303>When my part is complete, I shall stand apart and observe, as I have ever done. For it was to you that Venat has entrusted the future.<hex:0248020103>

63.original: Now then, to the matter at hand.

64.original: With the watcher's assistance, we shall reforge each of Zodiark's brands, and use them to erect a barrier capable of repelling voidsent.

65.original: Yet though we expect it to be effective against larger beings on account of its original purpose, there is a chance it will allow lesser voidsent to slip through.

66.original: Therefore we shall require a second line of defense─and I believe the Loporrits' supporters would be suitable for this purpose.

67.original: Urianger, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─the two of you have a strong rapport with our lunar allies. I would have you meet with Livingway in Bestways Burrow and provide any assistance they require.

68.original: I will join you. As a voidsent, my knowledge may be of use.

69.original: An excellent idea. In the meantime, the rest of us will see to reforging the brands. I will send word when we have finished─pray do the same.

71.original: Livingway, I trust thou hast been well?

72.original: First, we shall see to this brand.

73.original: We have matters here well in hand. Go, meet with the Loporrits.

74.original: We will have the brands in working order before you know it!

75.original: There you are! Y'shtola has apprised me of your present undertaking.

76.original: I understand that she wishes to deploy our pride and joy─the veritable carrots of our eye─our unrivaled combat supporters─as a precautionary measure in case this voidsent containment seal of hers proves lacking.

77.original: As we speak, my fellows are rounding up what units they can, and will bring them to the northeast corner in short order. Please wait there.

78.original: Despite their bestial appearance, these creatures are highly intelligent. And much like you and yours, they take pleasure in helping others...

79.original: Ever grateful am I for the Loporrits' irrepressible compulsion to help.

80.original: The Loporrits' eyes twinkle with anticipation as they await your buoyant extollation. To wit, they yearn for you to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> their spirits.

81.original: I wonder if these creatures also once existed on the void's moon... But even if they did, they must all be voidsent by now.

82.original: Though I fear my laudations will leave them wanting, I shall do mine utmost to rally the Loporrits.

83.original: To be clear, we will always do everything within our power to aid the people of Etheirys. As I'm sure you'll agree, though, it doesn't hurt to have a little encouragement!

84.original: The repairs? Oh, they proceed apace, I assure you! But...they might go even more swiftly if you were to spur us on. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> us, as it were... <wink> <wink>

86.original: Oh, what could be more splendiferous than to repair our supporters under the loving gaze of people from Etheirys! Nothing, I tell you! Nothing! Save for one such individual to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> us while we go about it, but a humble Loporrit can only dream...

87.original: N-Never fear, we shall ensure the supporters are ready for any voidsent brazen enough to slip through! And if they seem to struggle, we'll <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> them! Or at least we would, if someone were kind enough to demonstrate...

88.original: The Loporrits are doing their best to meet your expectations, and it is only fair that you return the favor. Shower them with all the encouragement you can muster and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> their spirits.

89.original: What a marvelous feeling! There's nothing like wild gesticulations of encouragement to fire you up!

91.original: Oh, sorry, I was in the midst of... Forgive me. The sight of precision parts is strangely soothing and sleep...inducing... But...I'll try to...keep moving... <yawn>

92.original: Hum hum-hummm～♪<hex:02100103>With you cheering me on, I can do naught less than my very best!

93.original: Oooh, thank you very, very much! You don't know how uplifting it is to have you encouraging us! I mean, uh, showing us the proper technique so we may keep our supporters operating at peak efficiency!

94.original: Forget two─at this rate, we'll finish in a carrot and a half!

96.original: Next to the maintenance of the atmospheric circulation system, making adjustments to these supporters is as easy as changing your socks!

97.original: Overclocking to increase maximum output... For the sake of the people of Etheirys, we cannot settle for “good enough”!

98.original: My, everyone is in high spirits indeed!

99.original: Thanks to your encouragement, we'll have the supporters up and running again in no time at all!

100.original: Pray attend to your remaining busywork, and leave the deployment of our new and improved voidsent slaughter-bots to us!
